name: Voxel Trilinear Interpolation (SIMD)
definition: Reads a voxel value from a 3D volume using trilinear interpolation with AVX instructions. Handles boundary checks and returns 0 if the sample point is outside the volume bounds.
summary: Voxel Trilinear Interpolation (SIMD) retrieves voxel data at arbitrary coordinates using trilinear interpolation, optimized for throughput by processing multiple components in parallel with vector registers to reduce instruction count.
